strategies.label: Observe only
strategies.detail: Measure the current product path without changing outputs.
strategies.operationalNote: Preserves quality and latency, but the deployed harm gap remains untreated.

strategies.label: Targeted safety reranking
strategies.detail: Generate three candidates only on a risk-triggered path and select with a group-audited scorer.
strategies.operationalNote: Reduces the gap while preserving most useful answers, but adds scorer dependency, latency, and candidate cost.

strategies.label: Broad refusal rule
strategies.detail: Refuse any request that crosses a coarse demographic-risk trigger.
strategies.operationalNote: Closes the measured harm gap, but rejects too many benign requests and fails the utility contract.
